Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in disambiguation at Step 1. Upon receiving search results that clearly identified "Aurora (2018 Filipino film)" directed by Yam Laranas, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the film corresponded to the Finnish drama "Aurora" (directed by Miia Tervo, released in 2019). The Planner failed to verify the release year and country of origin from the visible snippets (which explicitly stated "2018 Philippine horror thriller") and instead hallucinated a mismatch, leading the entire subsequent investigation down the wrong path toward the wrong director and the wrong birthplace (Rovaniemi instead of Davao).
